info.title: Matomo Reporting API for Referrers plugin

get.description: Returns the referrer overview report with distinct referrer counts and percentage metrics.

parameters.name: idSite
parameters.description: The site ID to query.

parameters.name: period
parameters.description: The period to process, processes data for the period containing the specified date.

parameters.name: date
parameters.description: The date or date range to process. 'YYYY-MM-DD', magic keywords (today, yesterday, lastWeek, lastMonth, lastYear), or date range (ie, 'YYYY-MM-DD,YYYY-MM-DD', lastX, previousX).

parameters.name: segment
parameters.description: Custom segment to filter the report. Example: "referrerName==example.com" Supports AND (;) and OR (,) operators.

parameters.name: columns
parameters.description: Specific columns to include, or `false` to return all columns.

200.description:
Referrer overview rows with summary counts and processed percentage metrics.

Example responses require Super User access. Use Try it out to see a live response.

get.description: Returns a report describing visit information for each possible referrer type. The result is a datatable whose subtables are the reports for each parent row's referrer type.

parameters.name: idSite
parameters.description: The site ID to query.

parameters.name: period
parameters.description: The period to process, processes data for the period containing the specified date.

parameters.name: date
parameters.description: The date or date range to process. 'YYYY-MM-DD', magic keywords (today, yesterday, lastWeek, lastMonth, lastYear), or date range (ie, 'YYYY-MM-DD,YYYY-MM-DD', lastX, previousX).

parameters.name: segment
parameters.description: Custom segment to filter the report. Example: "referrerName==example.com" Supports AND (;) and OR (,) operators.

parameters.name: typeReferrer
parameters.description: Deprecated referrer type filter to restrict the returned rows.

parameters.name: idSubtable
parameters.description: Referrer type ID to load directly instead of the overview report.

parameters.name: expanded
parameters.description: `true` to load subtables eagerly, `false` to return only top-level rows.

parameters.name: _setReferrerTypeLabel
parameters.description: `true` to replace referrer type IDs with human-readable labels.

200.description:
Report rows for each referrer type, or the selected referrer-type subreport.

Example responses require Super User access. Use Try it out to see a live response.

tags.name: Referrers
tags.description: The Referrers API lets you access reports about websites, search engines, keywords, social networks, AI assistants, and campaigns used to access your website. For example, "getKeywords" returns all search engine keywords (with general analytics metrics for each keyword), "getWebsites" returns referrer websites (along with the full Referrer URL if the parameter &expanded=1 is set). "getReferrerType" returns the Referrer overview report. "getCampaigns" returns the list of all campaigns (and all campaign keywords if the parameter &expanded=1 is set). "getSocials" returns social network referrers, and "getAIAssistants" returns AI assistant referrers.
